brief: the in-world library — books, notes, inscriptions and the unreliable written record
gap_closed: RI-UIX05 §D K9: book:item word ratio was 1.57 against a bar of >=15. It is now 30.72. game/data/books/ held 1,930 words in 7 texts; it holds 37,819 words in 65 texts.
outputs_written: game/data/books/foundational.json — the seven RI-LOR03 §3 exemplars, shipped out of the corpus markdown into the game (3,918 w)
game/data/books/the-drowned-tally.json — the Court's library and the argument the main quest is about; 6 texts incl. a 3-volume series
game/data/books/deep-time.json — 8 texts; The Stone Nests I-III, the three sealed-mystery evidence books, the UA-02 pair
game/data/books/quest-keys.json — 4 texts that shipped quests already required and that did not exist
game/data/books/the-occupation.json — 6 texts; the occupier's history and the occupied's, on the same events
game/data/books/a-progress-through-the-southern-marsh.json — 3 volumes by an author who did not go where he says he went
game/data/books/told-and-sung.json — 6 texts; folk tale, rhyme, bad verse, a chapel tract, a skill book, a rumour sheet
game/data/books/the-disputes.json — 2 texts closing CF-D004 and CF-D006, which were registered as disputed with no in-world source anywhere
game/data/books/scraps.json — 11 short forms: bill of lading, prayer-strips, a drowned marker, marginalia, a torn page, three tallies
tools/analysis/book-budget.mjs — RI-UIX05 §D, the instrument step 7 named and did not have
corpus/80-methods/book-stats.py — RI-LOR03 method steps 1/4/5/6/7, the instrument step 1 named by path and did not have
game/data/index.json — regenerated (generated manifest, not hand-authored content)

gates_run.both tools --self-test: every mutation caught; neither tool can pass a broken corpus

findings: DENOMINATOR: item `description` words across game/data/items/** = 1,231 across 44 records; game/data/weapons/** contributes none. 1930/1231 = 1.5678, which is exactly the 1.57 in the brief, so the ratio's denominator is confirmed to be the `description` field and nothing else.

PHANTOM TOOL: RI-LOR03 method step 1 names `python3 corpus/80-methods/book-stats.py` by path. It did not exist. RI-LOR03 has therefore never been measured — its length distribution, contradiction census, quest-hint ratio, register variance and Argonian-authorship count all name mechanical checks and none had an instrument. WRITTEN, and declared here per TOOL-LOOP rule 1.

PHANTOM FLAGS: RI-UIX05 method step 7 names `content-stats.mjs --books --items --dialogue --corroborate`. content-stats.mjs exists; none of those four flags does. They are parsed and silently discarded, and the tool computes NOT ONE of §D's six rows. This is the `cmb-reach.mjs --verify` failure again (TOOL-LOOP rule 3.5) and it is how K9 could be scored at all. WRITTEN as tools/analysis/book-budget.mjs, a separate file so content-stats.mjs (consumed by a dozen items) is not coupled to a UI item's budget.

EIGHT BOOK IDS WERE REFERENCED BY SHIPPED QUESTS AND DID NOT EXIST: book_the_court_and_the_tide (Q-SOUL-02 res_seal), book_the_rootless_egg (Q-LILM-01 res_rootkeepers), book_the_sap_and_the_knife (Q-DEEP-01 res_broker) — three non-violent resolutions whose requires.knowledge pointed at nothing on disk — plus book_the_seventh_recension, book_against_the_ninth_clause, book_for_the_ninth_clause, book_the_leave_book_of_thorn and item_ivo_sarns_book, all `channel: book` reveal sources in the mainline. All eight now exist and X3 checks the linkage.

THREE SEALED MYSTERIES NAMED BOOKS THAT DID NOT EXIST: M-01 book:on-the-tally-stones, M-02 book:the-oliis-bargain, M-03 book:valus-survey-fragment. All three written to under-determine their sealed answers; opacity-audit --leak-scan is CLEAN against all four sealed answers with the new corpus in the tree.

MAINLINE UA-02 declared `answered_in_a_book: true` and there were no such books. Written as an incompatible pair (the-house-built-in-reverence / the-house-built-in-fear); neither is corroborated and neither adjudicates.

TWO DISPUTED REGISTRY FACTS HAD NO IN-WORLD SOURCE ANYWHERE IN THE GAME: CF-D004 (is the Hist one mind or many) and CF-D006 (why is the Rootward Tide failing). A dispute with no source is a note dressed as a dispute — exactly what RI-LOR06's `held_by` field exists to prevent. Closed by game/data/books/the-disputes.json. All six disputed facts now have both sides in the library.

RI-UIX05 K1's `p10 >= 80` words-per-page ROW IS UNSATISFIABLE AS WRITTEN, and this is a corpus-side defect a UI builder will be charged for. The final page of a book is partial by construction. Measured over all 65 books with the SHIPPING pagination: all-pages p10 = 62, median 126, p90 153; excluding each book's final page, p10 = 95, median 130, p90 155. Same corpus, same layout, and only the second is inside B1. book-budget.mjs --pagination now reports both, labelled. K1's p10 must be scored on full pages or no corpus can pass it.

PAGINATION IS COMPUTABLE WITHOUT A BROWSER and the two agree to the page. bookPagination()/bookLayout() in game/src/ui/screens/text.js are pure arithmetic over the vector glyph tables in glyphs.js. Bare-Node pagination over the corpus gives 324 pages; opening all 65 books in the engine through openMenu('book',{id}) gives 324 pages. RI-UIX05 method step 2's distribution check does not need the browser it asks for.
ALL 65 BOOKS OPEN: openMenu('book',{id}) + getUIState().book verified 65/65 in a headless launch at 320x240 with renderRate 0.

ID COLLISION CAUGHT AND FIXED: `what-the-water-took` already existed in interface-readables.json. The engine keys books by id in a Map, so a duplicate silently wins and one of the two books becomes unreachable with no error anywhere. Renamed the new text to `what-the-water-went-round`; book-budget X1 now checks this across files.

THREE BOOKS TRIPPED RI-UIX05 §C's PROHIBITION SCAN ON IN-FICTION PROSE: step 6 scans getUIState() in mode 'book' for text matching `summary`, `codex`, `skip` and so on, and the book's own page text IS an element's text. 'the most exact summary of Argonian travel advice' and 'PREFACE, WHICH THE READER WILL SKIP' are prose, not UI affordances. Reworded all three so the corpus cannot generate a false R1 hit — but the scan should be scoped to element KINDS, not to page text, or the next library will trip it again.

MARKER DETECTION MUST NOT MATCH THE WORD 'marker'. The first version of book-budget flagged `march-marker` in a surveyor's monograph — a boundary stone, which RI-WLD06 §3 requires the world to have. The S8 patterns now name the UI affordance (quest/objective/map/compass marker, 'to the marker', waypoint, pin, minimap, coordinate pair) and leave the stones alone.

PRE-EXISTING, NOT MINE: `python3 corpus/80-methods/opacity-audit.py --seals` fails with `game/data/world/opacity.json` MISSING and 0 of 24 mysteries declared. That file is the world piece's deliverable (RI-WLD09 §B1). Three of its evidence books now exist, so whoever writes it can cite them.
not_closed: RI-LOR03 §2's full taxonomy target is 112 texts; the corpus is at 65. Every taxon T1-T10 is represented and every cross-cutting quota is met (>=14 Argonian-authored: 19; >=8 contradicting pairs: 24; >=6 wrong on purpose: 8; >=3 multi-volume series: 3; <=10% quest hints: 0%), and the SHAPE of the distribution is in band, but the raw count is 47 short of RI-LOR03's own minimum and that item scores count as well as shape.
The `skill book` overlay tag wants >=26 tagged texts and only one text carries `skill_book`. The convention (teach sideways, never instruct) is demonstrated but not populated.

RI-LOR03 method steps 2 and 3 — the blind pair against real Morrowind books, and the author-voice test — are judgements and are not in book-stats.py. They need a critic with fresh context and eight unlabelled texts; RI-MTH03 owns the protocol.
game/data/world/opacity.json still does not exist, so the 24-mystery register is unverifiable regardless of the library. Not my deliverable; flagged above.
notes_for_successor: Do NOT let a generator overwrite these files — they are hand-authored and `node tools/check-content.mjs` only guards quest resolutions, not books. Run `node tools/analysis/book-budget.mjs --corroborate --pagination` and `python3 corpus/80-methods/book-stats.py game/data/books/` after any change; both exit non-zero on a regression and both have a --self-test that proves they can. No book may be corrected by another book or annotated by the UI (RI-UIX05 R8 / RI-LOR06 §1.2). Directions in book text are prose under RI-WLD06 §4 grammar and there are no markers anywhere (S8).
